# T3: roots (generated by roots_holder.py)

(a) Lemma S3 checked in 742 cluster instances (9 multisets, random e-perturbations of normalised size 1e-3..1e-12): every cluster has exactly k roots inside r_a. Largest (actual displacement)/r_a by k: k=1: 0.105, k=2: 0.402, k=3: 0.692, k=4: 0.779.

## (d) Realisable perturbations of a triple order: exponent 1/2

For real d with |d_i| <= a:  (P_3 - 3a^2 P_1)(a+d) - (same)(a) = 3a sum d_i^2 + sum d_i^3 >= 2a sum d_i^2,
so max|d_i|^2 <= sum d^2 <= |dP_3 - 3a^2 dP_1|/(2a): Hoelder 1/2 for heat data of real multisets.

Checked on 900 random real perturbations (a = 4, 7, 10); largest max|d|^2 / bound = 0.664.
